steps.title: Analyze Resource Load Failures
steps.description: Inspect the project's drawable resources and identify the target image filenames (asset_6a9f18319c82d and asset_6a9f1839db93c) and their fallback assets.

steps.title: Enforce Safe Dynamic Asset Retrieval
steps.description: Implement dynamic resource lookup inside ImageSandboxView to automatically scan for all available assets in drawable resources.

steps.title: Resolve Null Bitmap References
steps.description: Ensure beautiful procedural image placeholders are generated dynamically if any asset is corrupted or missing.

steps.title: Expose Asset Name Metadata
steps.description: Expose loaded asset names from ImageSandboxView to MainActivity to synchronize dynamic UI descriptions.

steps.title: Implement Paint Reset Mechanism
steps.description: Enforce a strict state-reset in onDraw by resetting the alpha value of the Paint instance to prevent opacity carryover from Alpha Blend mode.

steps.title: Remove Forbidden Dependencies
steps.description: Strip out external dependencies like org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd in app/build.gradle to comply with standard native rules.

steps.title: Maintain Strict Java 8 Compliance
steps.description: Verify and ensure all modifications in MainActivity and ImageSandboxView use traditional anonymous classes rather than lambda expressions or method references.

steps.title: Test Comparison Rendering
steps.description: Validate clipping math, rotation matrices, and overlay sliders with the newly loaded bitmaps.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Compliance
steps.description: Confirm the correct XML namespace declaration and activity configurations are fully intact.

steps.title: Building PicBlend Compare
steps.description: Compile the updated project and assets using the Java 17 and AGP 8.3.2 pipeline to generate the debug APK.
